decision_log.decision: Universe = 36 hosted World Expos 1851-2025 (NOT '~30+' from cycle-0) per audit-cycle-1 amendment #2
decision_log.rationale: Audit-cycle-1 verified exact count: 19 pre-BIE rows (through 1915 San Francisco) + 17 BIE-era rows (1929 Barcelona through 2025 Osaka) = 36 total. Cycle-0 estimate '~30+' was imprecise; audit corrected to exact 36.

decision_log.decision: Excluded: Expo 2030 Riyadh + Specialised Expos + Horticultural Expos + Tokyo 1940 + Rome 1942 per audit-cycle-1 amendments #1 + #3
decision_log.rationale: ID says 'hosted_since_1851' so Expo 2030 Riyadh (scheduled, not yet hosted) is out of scope. Specialised + Horticultural sub-tables are different categories in the master. Vancouver 1986 falls under Specialised Expos (NOT World Expos). Tokyo 1940 + Rome 1942 were cancelled and not in master's hosted World Expos table.

decision_log.decision: Schema = composite PK (Year, Host City) + 5 cols total per audit-cycle-1 amendment #4
decision_log.rationale: Cycle-0 proposed Expo (single PK) with verbatim master cell. Audit-cycle-1 amendment #4: master table does NOT display an explicit Expo-name column; the master uses just Year + Location + Dates + Theme structure. Composite PK (Year, Host City) avoids per-row link-target extraction. 5 cols: Year + Host City + Country + Dates + Theme.

decision_log.decision: BIE Classification column DROPPED per audit-cycle-1 amendment #5
decision_log.rationale: BIE Classification (Pre-BIE vs World Expo) is NOT a master table column. Adds little since all staged rows are from the master's World Expos table (uniform category). Pre-BIE vs BIE-era distinction documented in this decision_log + temporal_note instead.

decision_log.decision: Pre-BIE vs BIE-era documented (audit-cycle-1 amendment #5 alternative documentation)
decision_log.rationale: Master's framing: pre-1928 rows are 'pre-BIE' (before the 1928 Convention Relating to International Exhibitions established BIE as international sanctioning body); post-1928 rows are 'BIE-era' (BIE-sanctioned). Pre-BIE rows in staged universe: 19 (1851 London through 1915 San Francisco). BIE-era rows: 17 (1929 Barcelona through 2025 Osaka). This distinction is documented for transparency but NOT staged as a column to avoid adding non-master-native columns.

decision_log.decision: Country cells = visible master table text per audit-cycle-2 ruling (cycle-1 'period-accurate' framing corrected)
decision_log.rationale: Cycle-1 per-question ruling initially said 'period-accurate per master' which was an overstatement — master uses visible-text formatting that happens to include period-accurate labels for 2 rows (Austria-Hungary 1873 Vienna; Colony of Victoria 1880 Melbourne pre-Australian-federation 1901) but uses plain modern country names for other historical rows where flag-link wikitext metadata points to period-accurate state articles. Cycle-2 verification audit caught that cycle-0 had staged the FLAG-LINK metadata for 3 rows (Restoration (Spain) for 1929 Barcelona; French Third Republic for 1937 Paris; Republic of Haiti (1859–1957) for 1949 Port-au-Prince) instead of the VISIBLE TEXT (Spain / France / Haiti). The corrected rule applied uniformly across all 36 rows: stage visible-master-text only. Cycle-2 fix harmonized the 3 mis-staged cells; cycle-1 historical wording about 'period-accurate' is preserved in audit_trail historical narration but the active rule is visible-master-text.

Per audit-cycle-1 per-question ruling: master-native chronological sort. Within-year tiebreak by Host City ASC (not triggered at the 36-row universe since each Year is unique except for Osaka appearing in 1970 + 2025 which are distinct years).

decision_log.decision: Domain = History/Cultural Events (NEW subdomain) per audit-cycle-1 per-question ruling
decision_log.rationale: Cycle-0 proposed Culture/Heritage existing as primary domain choice; audit-cycle-1 per-question ruling preferred History/Cultural Events because expos are HOSTED EVENTS not heritage properties (Culture/Heritage applies to UNESCO World Heritage Sites which are heritage properties). History/Cultural Events NEW subdomain under History family. Audit explicit preference.

Two rows have period-accurate labels in the visible master text: 'Austria-Hungary' (1873 Vienna — matches Austro-Hungarian Empire at time of hosting); 'Colony of Victoria' (1880 Melbourne — matches pre-Australian-federation 1901 colonial entity). CSV cells with commas or special characters quoted as needed.

Master verbatim from Theme column (italics formatting removed; text preserved). Punctuation preserved including periods, commas, colons, en-dashes (e.g., 'Humankind – Nature – Technology' with en-dashes between words; '19th century: an overview' with colon; 'The independence among Industry and scientific research.' with terminal period). CSV cells with commas quoted.

open_questions.question: If Expo 2030 Riyadh is hosted in 2030-2031, would the staged universe extend to 37 rows?
open_questions.answer: Yes — temporal_sensitivity=medium captures this future-extension. Year-anchor accessed 2026-05-20 marks the current 36-row state. When Expo 2030 hosting commences, future-cycle re-curation can extend to 37.

open_questions.question: Should Theme cells preserve master's italic formatting?
open_questions.answer: No — staged Theme cells use plain text (italics formatting dropped). Master's italics are display-formatting, not semantic content; the text itself is preserved. If a future-cycle audit prefers explicit-italic markup (e.g., '_Industry of all Nations_' with underscore-italics marker), the cells can be reformatted.

open_questions.question: Why is Expo 2020 Dubai's Year staged as 2020 when actual hosting was 2021-2022?
open_questions.answer: Master uses the official BIE-designated Expo year (2020) for the Year column even though COVID-19 delayed actual hosting to October 2021 - March 2022. The staged Year cell follows master's official designation; the actual hosting dates are preserved in the Dates cell. This matches BIE's convention of preserving the originally-designated Expo year regardless of delays.

open_questions.question: Should the universe expand to include Specialised + Horticultural Expos in a future-cycle re-curation?
open_questions.answer: Open for future-cycle consideration. The current 36-row universe is restricted to master's 'World Expos' table per audit-cycle-1 amendment #1. A broader universe including Specialised + Horticultural would extend to 100+ rows and would change the entity-class framing (currently world-expositions; could shift to a broader expo-events fine-class).
